name: Komazawa-Daigaku
tagline: Shibuya in 10 minutes and Shinjuku in 20 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 33 minutes to Otemachi, 20 minutes to Shinjuku, 10 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 41 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 41 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 34.9 m to 43 m, a difference of 8.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 5 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 平和協会駒沢病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 国立病院機構 東京医療センター, about 16 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line.
congestion: Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line runs at 138% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池尻大橋→渋谷, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Taishido is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is, but Komazawa-Daigaku is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Komazawa-Daigaku in a straight line. Nishi-Taishido has the Tokyu Setagaya Line, a different set from Komazawa-Daigaku. To Toranomon, for instance, Nishi-Taishido takes 5 minutes longer. On safety, Komazawa-Daigaku comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Shoin-Jinja-Mae is ahead on the number of medical facilities and quiet, but Komazawa-Daigaku is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Komazawa-Daigaku in a straight line. Shoin-Jinja-Mae has the Tokyu Setagaya Line, a different set from Komazawa-Daigaku. To Toranomon, for instance, Shoin-Jinja-Mae takes 10 minutes longer. On quiet, Shoin-Jinja-Mae comes out ahead.

goodFor: People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The 首都高速3号渋谷線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
玉川通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
